prompts.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create a single ultra-photoreal cinematic movie frame, 16:9 wide landscape, for a fictional Australian freight dispatcher story. Before dawn inside a modest but modern freight operations office in Perth. A woman in her early forties, naturally textured skin, dark brown hair in a low ponytail, navy cotton work shirt, sits at a charcoal desk preparing a shipment. She is positioned in the left third, seen in a thoughtful three-quarter profile, eyes looking down toward a printed sheet held lightly in one hand. A generic unbranded open laptop is on the desk near centre-right, its blank dark navy screen facing diagonally toward camera and completely visible. A small amber desk lamp, paper manifest, pen, mug and truck keys provide believable working detail. Through the windows: dim freight yard and a silver-white conventional-cab road train, out of focus. Quiet blue dawn mixed with warm tungsten practical light; natural, understated expression, no posing or smiling at camera. Large-format cinema camera, 50mm anamorphic lens, gentle depth of field, authentic skin and fabric detail, rich but not crushed dark tones, no exaggerated flare. Premium documentary realism, no glossy artificial skin. No visible text or logos anywhere, no watermark, no UI. Do not resemble a known public figure. This character will recur in later shots; make her features clear and consistent.

Use case: identity-preserve / cinematic story continuity. Reference image is the fictional freight dispatcher and her exact office, not a real person identity. Create a new shot in the SAME fictional story, preserving precisely this woman's facial identity, dark brown ponytail, navy work shirt, generic laptop, charcoal desk, amber lamp and windowed freight office. The time is now a grey overcast morning. Medium close-up from slightly behind her left shoulder: she has set the paper down and is looking intently at her laptop, one hand naturally resting on the trackpad. Calm concentrated concern, not panic. Her face is visible in profile in the left third; laptop with a fully visible clean blank navy screen occupies middle-right. Through the window, the truck that was parked earlier has departed; empty wet freight yard, distant out-of-focus warehouse lights. Beautiful layered realistic optical depth, natural skin pores and fabric texture, subtle anamorphic falloff, no excessive flare. A credible documentary cinema frame. 16:9 landscape. Do not add text or UI to screen; that will be composited later. No visible logos, no brand names, no watermark. Not an illustration. Do not change the woman's face or wardrobe.

Use case: compositing asset for a photoreal cinematic film. Reference gives the precise fictional office, generic laptop, woman and lighting. Create a new close-up shot from the woman's viewpoint, focusing on the SAME unbranded open laptop on the charcoal desk. The entire laptop display must dominate centre frame, roughly 65% of frame width, with a fully blank very dark navy screen, no text or reflections obscuring its surface. Laptop is almost front-facing, only slight perspective, the four inner screen corners all clearly visible. Small portion of her navy-shirt shoulder softly blurred at far left; her hand lightly on the trackpad in lower frame. Warm amber desk lamp at far right edge, grey rain-wet freight yard blurred through the background window. Realistic glass reflection along edges, credible laptop construction and keyboard, shallow optical depth. Camera is close enough for the screen to become readable when precise graphics are composited. 16:9 landscape, luxury documentary cinema lighting, no generated interface, no text, no logos, no watermark.

Use case: compositing asset for a photoreal cinematic film. Reference defines the fictional woman's hands, navy cotton work shirt, charcoal office desk, warm lamp and cool grey daylight. New close-up shot looking almost straight down at the desk at a gentle 15-degree angle. A single blank uncreased matte off-white A4 paper sheet in portrait orientation dominates the centre, all four corners visible, occupying about 55 percent of frame width and 80 percent of height. It rests flat on the desk. The woman's right hand holding a black pen is near the right outside edge of the paper, poised to review, does NOT overlap the blank printable area. Left hand gently rests on desk outside lower-left of paper. An out-of-focus laptop edge at top, subtle lamp light from upper right. Natural skin, tactile paper grain, restrained shadow and real optics. Keep the paper absolutely blank with NO writing, NO seals and NO printed details because exact draft typography will be composited later. Single cinematic 16:9 landscape image, photoreal, no watermark or logos.

Create a single photoreal cinematic 16:9 frame. High drone aerial over the immense Australian Nullarbor plain, long straight asphalt highway diagonal from lower left to distant upper right, one small silver-white conventional cab road train with two trailers traveling east. Pale golden early morning sunlight, subtle atmospheric haze, red earth and sparse sage scrub, no mountains, no buildings. Unbranded real-world freight documentary, natural proportions, luxury large-format cinema photography. Landscape overwhelmingly vast, truck small, restrained earthy colour grade, genuine tactile detail, no text no graphics no watermark.

Create a single photoreal cinematic 16:9 frame. Silver-white conventional cab Australian road train with two trailers parked safely inside a spacious designated gravel rest bay beside a remote Nullarbor highway, clearly off the through traffic lane. Late afternoon after rain, soft sunlight breaking through clouds, glistening silver truck, red earth and low scrub, large quiet sky. Side three-quarter wide camera, grounded weight and realistic wheels. Mood: composure, thoughtful preparation, no emergency. Premium anamorphic cinema optics, natural colours, restrained horizontal highlight at sun only, no text no logos no watermark.

Using the reference's same fictional woman, navy work shirt, low brown ponytail, charcoal desk and freight office, create a new photoreal cinematic 16:9 medium close shot from the opposite side of her desk. She calmly writes brief notes on a paper on the desk with her right hand, eyes down in concentration. Screen of laptop turned away at far right, do not show text. Grey daylight after rain mixes with amber desk lamp. Natural skin detail, anatomically correct hands, subtle documentary acting, premium 65mm anamorphic photography with gentle shallow focus, natural colours, no exaggerated flare, no text no logos no watermark. Preserve identity exactly, no smile or look at camera.
